feature.label: Directory
feature.description: Member profiles with searchable directory, configurable fields, skills, roles and visibility.

messages.membersText: Find people by role, team, location, skills or profile details.
messages.displayNameHint: Shown in the directory and forum posts.
messages.jobTitleHint: Used as the compact role line on profile cards.
messages.departmentHint: Helps users filter by team or group.
messages.avatarUrlHint: HTTPS image URL or safe data image.
messages.profileVisibilityHint: Controls the overall profile listing visibility.
messages.bioHint: Short introduction for colleagues or community members.
messages.skillsHint: Choose skills or interests that should appear as badges.
messages.fieldNameHint: Label shown on profile forms and detail pages.
messages.fieldTypeHint: Controls the input used for this profile attribute.
messages.visibilityDefaultHint: Users can override it per field value.
messages.skillNameHint: Appears as a badge on profiles and forum posts.
messages.profilesAdminHint: Select a user and maintain their public directory information.
messages.fieldsAdminHint: Configure additional profile attributes and their default visibility.
messages.skillsAdminHint: Manage reusable skills, interests and badges for profiles and forum cards.
messages.permissionsAdminHint: Assign directory capabilities to Atlas roles. Admin users keep full access automatically.
